title: fix(app-shell): the metadata editor's save-status chip reads "Not saved" while a refused auto-save is held
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4xjiquevJqfBXiUoqfQwa1)_

Fixes #29901

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 元数据编辑页(Studio「全部元数据」条目页、Setup 元数据页)工具栏上 Save 旁的保存状态提示,新增「未保存」状态:服务端以 422 拒收草稿、或检查器挡着一个错误(如 CEL 解析失败)时,显示红色「未保存 — 修正错误后才能保存」,悬停给出与 Save 按钮相同的原因;不再显示琥珀色「自动保存中…」。
- **为什么改:** 被拒后自动保存其实已停(不会再发 PUT),提示却一直说「自动保存中…」,作者只看提示会以为已保存,离开页面就丢了修改(p2)。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改提示的显示,何时保存、何时挡住完全不变;读的就是已经挡住自动保存和 Save 按钮的两个信号,不重算。新增一条中英文文案。`@object-ui/app-shell`、`@object-ui/i18n` patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ResourceEditPage.tsx` 的 `SaveStatusIndicator`(新的 `held` 分支)及其渲染处传入的 `held={inspectorBlocking > 0 || refusalBlocking > 0}`;测试 `ResourceEditPage.serverRefusalGate.test.tsx` 末尾的 `(#29901)` describe。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.serverRefusalGate.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.celGate.test.tsx`,预期 `18 passed`。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx` → `SaveStatusIndicator`.** The chip gains a sixth state, `held`. While the page is dirty and a save door is shut on the draft, it reads `engine.edit.notSavedHeld` ("Not saved — fix the errors to save") in the destructive tone, with the Save button's own explanation (`saveTitle`) as its `title`. It outranks the auto-save promise and the plain "Unsaved" state; `saving` still outranks it, and create mode still hides the chip.
- **The signal is passed down, not recomputed:** the render site passes `held={inspectorBlocking > 0 || refusalBlocking > 0}`, the same two terms that return the auto-save effect early and disable the Save button and the shortcut. When either term lifts, the chip falls back to "Auto-saving…" / "Unsaved" / "Saved HH:MM" as before.
- Every chip state now carries `data-testid="save-status"` and a `data-state` (`saving`, `held`, `autosave-pending`, `unsaved`, `saved`), so tests read the kind, not the copy.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`, studio namespace:** `engine.edit.notSavedHeld` in `en.ts` and `zh.ts`, beside `engine.edit.autoSavingShortly`. Nothing under `packages/spec/**` moved.
- Nothing about when a save is sent or held changes.

## Why

Card #29901: after the server refuses an auto-saved draft with `422 INVALID_METADATA`, the auto-save effect returns early on `refusalBlocking > 0`, so no further PUT is sent, but the chip kept reading "Auto-saving…" for as long as the page stayed dirty, beside the red banners. An author who reads the chip believes the edit is stored and loses it on the next navigation.

**Which holds are covered, and why (measured on `origin/main` `8a608d87`):** the auto-save effect has two validation returns, `inspectorBlocking > 0` (an author-time fault the inspector reports, e.g. a CEL predicate that does not parse, kept with the draft slice it judged) and `refusalBlocking > 0` (the server's 422, document-scoped). Both hold the auto-save the same way, so the chip must not promise a save under either; both are covered. The client's live Zod pass is not a term: per the boundary written in the page (`9073cf018`), a predicted verdict stays advisory, and the chip follows the save doors rather than gating anything.

## Acceptance notes

- **A refusal that localises to no slice (`held: []`) is not a hold, and the chip does not call it one.** By design that refusal gates nothing and Save stays enabled. The auto-save does not re-send the identical snapshot either (`lastAutoSaveSnapshotRef`), so until the author's next edit the chip still reads "Auto-saving…" while nothing is sent; the next edit of any kind does send. Left as it is: the order scopes this card to the two terms that hold the auto-save, and showing "Not saved" for an unheld refusal would be wrong again the moment an edit re-arms the timer. Noted, not filed.
- With auto-save off, a held draft now reads "Not saved" instead of "Unsaved": the same two terms disable Save, so the stronger state is the accurate one there too.
- #27482 (whether an expression refusal holds the save) is untouched.

## Verification

Head `4c50f374`, worktree off `origin/main` `8a608d87` (after #29897's `04cbdf78b`).

- **New pins**, in the existing shared harnesses as top-level describes:
  - `ResourceEditPage.serverRefusalGate.test.tsx` → `the save-status chip while a refusal holds auto-save (#29901)`:
    - CONTROL: an ordinary dirty edit with auto-save on reads `autosave-pending`, saves once, then reads `saved`.
    - The card's path: the auto-saved `client.save(…, { mode: 'draft' })` (the `PUT …?mode=draft` door) answers 422 `INVALID_METADATA` through the real `MetadataClient` parser; the chip reads `held` with the server-refused title, still `held` past the debounce and after an unrelated edit, and `client.save` stays at one call.
    - Recovery: editing the slice the server named lifts the hold, the second save is accepted, the chip reads `saved`.
  - `ResourceEditPage.celGate.test.tsx` → `the save-status chip while the inspector holds auto-save (#29901)`: a good predicate reads `autosave-pending`, a dangling operator reads `held` with the inspector title, a parseable one reads `autosave-pending` again.
- Both files: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 18 passed (18)`.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `    if (held) {` → `    if (false && held) {`, x1 → x0, restored to the HEAD blob `57cd4216ded4` with `git diff HEAD` empty): `3 failed | 15 passed (18)`, all three new held/recovery tests with `expected 'autosave-pending' to be 'held'`; both CONTROLs stayed green.
- `@object-ui/app-shell...` closure build (turbo, 68 tasks): exit 0.
- Every test file that imports `ResourceEditPage` (106 files): `Test Files 106 passed · Tests 962 passed`. The full app-shell suite is CI's Test UI.
- `@object-ui/i18n` suite (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/`, includes `all-locales-key-parity`): `95 passed · 1443 passed / 13 skipped`.
- `type-check` (`pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`): exit 0 for both.
- `eslint` as the package `lint` script runs it, on the three app-shell files: 0 errors; no warning on a changed line.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0 (`sdui.manifest.json is present and intact`; no registry change). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on head `4c50f374`: 35 derived commands, all 35 exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` ran its own full-packages build under the lock). `dispatch-gates --ran`: `35 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
